verdict.rationale: Retell's Mintlify-hosted API reference runs an interactive playground with a "Try it" runner per endpoint, for example POST /v2/create-phone-call, plus per-language SDK examples. That directly delivers an explorable reference with runnable examples. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Try-it runner works across endpoints, and broader first-party documentation beyond the single example endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
